name: anagram_wordplay
description: Word play: single- and multi-word anagrams from a word list, palindrome check ignoring punctuation, case and accents, lipogram check with offsets, the shortest word ladder between two words, and letter frequencies with a pangram check. Word lists come from the input, plus an optional bundled English list of 29,483 words (SCOWL/ESDB size 35, permissive licence).

text.description: Word, phrase or text (anagrams, palindrome, lipogram, letter_frequency)

bundled.description: Add the bundled English list (lowercase words of 1 to 9 letters)

multi_word.description: anagrams: also phrases of several words
